recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量中大型母細胞佔滿，核染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質淡藍，部分帶少量顆粒；其間仍有嗜酸性前驅細胞與成熟顆粒球，顯示母細胞增生伴隨成熟，符合 AML with maturation。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm, some with sparse fine azurophilic granules
Occasional maturing granulocytes, including an eosinophilic precursor with coarse orange-brown granules and a band neutrophil
Scattered promyelocytes/myelocytes with more abundant granular cytoplasm
No convincing Auer rods in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed predominantly of medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing occasional fine granules. A minority of maturing granulocytic cells is present, including promyelocytes/myelocytes, an eosinophil precursor and band neutrophils. Auer rods are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation; cytochemistry, flow cytometry and genetic studies are needed to exclude defined genetic subtypes.

ddx.vs: It shares blasts with maturation but typically shows abundant salmon-pink granules, long Auer rods and increased eosinophil precursors; confirmation requires cytogenetics/molecular testing.

It shows myelomonocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils containing large purple-basophilic granules, whereas the eosinophil precursor here has orange granules without obvious monocytic component.
MDS with increased blasts has fewer than 20% blasts with multilineage dysplasia, whereas this field is dominated by blasts.
